item.title: Thieves break into Bronzeville business, steal two cash registers and 27 cases of liquor
item.description: Thieves stole two cash registers from a South Side liquor store early Sunday morning, Chicago police said.

item.title: Students, parents rally at archdiocese in effort to save St. Hubert Catholic School from closure
item.description: Students and parents are calling on Cardinal Blase Cupich to meet with them in an effort to discuss new information they believe can save St. Hubert Catholic School.

item.title: Quick Tip: Tax scams
item.description: The Better Business Bureau is warning taxpayers about a surge in scams designed to steal your money and your identity.

item.title: National Association of Letter Carriers rally on South Side ahead of USPS contract negotiations
item.description: Letter carriers in Chicago joined a national day of action as union leaders are calling for a fair contract. Negotiations are expected to get underway with the United States Postal Service in Washington, D.C. on Wednesday.

item.title: Person in custody after 15-year-old boy accidentally shot in Morgan Park home: CPD
item.description: One person is in custody after a teenage boy was injured in an accidental shooting inside a South Side home on Sunday morning, Chicago police said.

item.title: Mexican army kills leader of powerful Jalisco New Generation Cartel, 'El Mencho,' during operation
item.description: Videos show plumes of smoke over the city of Puerto Vallarta and travelers sprinting through the airport of the state's capital in panic.

item.title: DHS suspends Global Entry as partial government shutdown drags on; PreCheck still operational
item.description: DHS said Sunday that the Global Entry program would be shut down as long as the partial government shutdown continues. It comes after the department said it planned to shut down TSA PreCheck as well, but DHS later canceled the PreCheck closure.

item.title: Good Samaritans help reunite dog stolen near day care in Lincoln Park with Chicago family
item.description: A dog who was stolen from outside a day care on Chicago's North Side has been found. Good Samaritans recognized him after seeing ABC7's story and found the pet at a grocery store in Uptown, the owners said.

item.title: Flights canceled at Chicago airports amid winter storm, confusion over TSA PreCheck, Global Entry
item.description: TSA announced that PreCheck services will continue to operate without change, despite a DHS announcement. Meanwhile, flights have been canceled and delayed at Chicago airports amid a major nor'easter winter storm.

item.title: Local travelers stranded in Mexico amid unrest over death of cartel leader, top Chicago DEA fugitive
item.description: ABC7 heard from Chicago-area travelers currently in Mexico. There's a lot of uncertainty as clashes erupt throughout parts of the country following the death of "El Mencho," one of the Chicago DEA's most-wanted drug lords.
